method: built-in image_gen, three wholly new native images, no partial edits; genuine output-derived masks

toolArgs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Make ONE completely NEW full image, native1536x1024 landscape3:2. STRICT CAMERA-TEMPLATE RECONSTRUCTION of the supplied first image, which is an authorized own-game K42 render. Generate all pixels fresh, not a patch/retouch or photo collage. The requested result is an excellent REAL-CAMERA PHOTOGRAPH of exactly this scene projection with the same building sizes, placement and crop.

PRIORITY1: REFERENCE1 is the binding screen-space camera and placement of ALL building masses. Keep its lens, elevation, view direction, perspective, zoom, rooflines, eaves, facade/ground boundary and exact relative positions unchanged. The gray courtyard area starts on exactly the SAME row at each horizontal pixel as in reference1. Do NOT expand the facade downward to show more architecture; do NOT let the camera fall to street level; do not make a prettier composition. Keep precisely the first image's amount of sky, palace, courtyard, and all edge cutoffs. Draw realistic architecture ON THIS EXACT PROJECTION. This is a camera-match engineering target, not a new tourist photograph from a similar view. Silhouette overlaps will be measured.

REFERENCE2 is the matching white-on-black building silhouette for checking geometry, not output style. Inside the same silhouette, make window frames, pilasters, cornices, arches, sculptures, slate roofs and materials architecturally realistic. Never reproduce the first render's blank flat walls or texture maps; these are the part that needs to look photographic. Do not change the exterior envelope to add realistic detail. All other references are surface/architectural-detail references ONLY, NOT their street-level camera, composition, crowds, background or sky.

Authentic pale warm honey-beige limestone with subtle varying blocks, occasional restrained weather stains under ledges, relief sculpture and credible recess depth. Real blue-gray slate/lead, fine roof seams, real chimneys; no jagged LiDAR blocks, melted chunks, vertical data striations or fantasy roof shapes. Natural lens sharpness, diffuse sky fill and bright summer sun from SOUTH at45degrees. Keep overall realistic restrained light, subtle wear and material variation; no patterned global grain, engraved microtexture, repeated fake detail, oversharpening halos or game-like flat shader. Stone detail should look optical, not painted decoration.

FORBIDDEN THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE PICTURE: glass pyramids of any size, triangular glass planes, diagonal glass grids, metal pyramid frames, pyramid fragments, reflected pyramids, basins, fountains and reflecting pools. INSPECT the little openings: THROUGH EVERY OPEN ARCH AND PASSAGE, show ONLY darker courtyard paving, deep plain shadow or opaque masonry. NO distant triangle, glass grid, patterned diagonal metal gate or structure seen through a central arch. Remove all pyramid imagery even if a detail photo contains it. The courtyard continues as level stone/sand surface where such objects would be. No modern art, people, cars, flags, logos, advertising or game UI. Only tiny exact lowercase word 'havainnekuva' in bottomright corner; no other text or border/vignette. Whole native1536x1024 image.

Low linking roof aroundy340-380px. Facade arcade meets ground aroundy735px across frame; bottomroughly280px remains courtyard, not extra lower storeys. Preserve this ground contact, do NOT move it down to800px. Keep first render's right pavilions and left mansard profile, building ends cut at same image edges. Apply true Richelieu courtyard vocabulary from reference3: rounded ground arcade, pilasters, accurately scaled windows, niche statues, pediment, dormers and roof sculpture, but all features fit WITHIN the existing silhouette and same floor heights. Remaining courtyard: LARGE lightgray GRANITE slabs with visible appropriately wide-set seams and understated worn/damp patches, not tiny cobblestones.
